items.description: The Lacandon Jungle in Chiapas is one of North America's last major rainforests, home to the indigenous Lacandon Maya.
El Vizcaíno Biosphere Reserve in Baja California Sur is Latin America's largest protected area and a gray whale breeding ground.
Celestún Flamingo Reserve in Yucatán is famous for its large colonies of flamingos and diverse birdlife.
La Ventanilla Turtle Reserve in Oaxaca protects sea turtles and other coastal wildlife.
Los Tuxtlas Biosphere Reserve in Veracruz is a unique cloud forest ecosystem with exceptionally high biodiversity.
Sierra Gorda Biosphere Reserve in Querétaro is a diverse mountainous region with rich flora and fauna.
Isla Holbox in Quintana Roo is a car-free island, known for its pristine beaches and whale shark encounters.
Isla Mujeres is a small Caribbean island off Cancún, popular for its beaches, coral reefs, and underwater museum.
Janitzio Island in Lake Pátzcuaro, Michoacán, is famous for its giant statue of José María Morelos and indigenous culture.
Isla Espíritu Santo in Baja California Sur is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, known for its pristine nature and sea lion colonies.
